title: A finite field extension lies in a finite normal extension (Stacks 09DT)
statement: Let $K$ be a field and $L/K$ a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension] ($\dim_KL<\infty$). Then there is a field extension $M/L$ such that $M/K$ (via $K\to L\to M$) is finite and normal: every $\beta\in M$ is algebraic over $K$ [def-weil-algebraic-element] and its minimal polynomial over $K$ is a product of polynomials of degree one in $M[T]$.
